title: Choose your focus
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: Tilted statistics stickers give way to a focus-selection screen. Pastel pills for activities such as writing, cooking, reading, and exercise change positions and collect into a layered pile with shadows. A segmented progress indicator and black Continue button frame the activity.
learning_candidate: Physical-looking choices can add personality; the sampled frames do not establish whether movement is touch- or motion-sensor-driven.
